description: This file contains platform-specific functions for firmware upgrade procedures in an OpenWrt-based embedded system. It defines variables, licenses, and functions to check firmware images and perform upgrades for various device models, referencing external tools and configurations.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image for compatibility based on board name and magic number, allowing only supported images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific firmware upgrade procedures based on the board model, including backup, erasing, or flashing firmware.
